name: Lake Turkana National Parks
description: Three parks cluster around Lake Turkana in northern Kenya: Sibiloi on the shore, plus Central and South Islands out on the water. Turkana is the saltiest of Africa's large lakes, and its shores and islands host migrating waterfowl, crocodiles, hippos and venomous snakes. Fossil-rich Koobi Fora has taught scientists more about ancient environments than any other African site. The site is listed as in danger.
